mapper.select: SELECT b.booking_id, b.user_id, b.site_id, b.type_id, b.check_in, b.check_out, b.guest_name, b.guest_phone, b.total_price, b.status, b.create_time, b.update_time, s.site_no, st.type_name, COALESCE(string_agg(e.equip_name || 'x' || be.quantity, ', '), '') AS equipments FROM bookings b LEFT JOIN sites s ON b.site_id = s.site_id LEFT JOIN site_types st ON b.type_id = st.type_id LEFT JOIN booking_equips be ON b.booking_id = be.booking_id LEFT JOIN equipments e ON be.equip_id = e.equip_id WHERE b.booking_id = #{bookingId} GROUP BY b.booking_id, s.site_no, st.type_name

SELECT b.booking_id, b.user_id, b.site_id, b.type_id, b.check_in, b.check_out, b.guest_name, b.guest_phone, b.total_price, b.status, b.create_time, b.update_time, s.site_no, st.type_name, COALESCE(string_agg(e.equip_name || 'x' || be.quantity, ', '), '') AS equipments FROM bookings b LEFT JOIN sites s ON b.site_id = s.site_id LEFT JOIN site_types st ON b.type_id = st.type_id LEFT JOIN booking_equips be ON b.booking_id = be.booking_id LEFT JOIN equipments e ON be.equip_id = e.equip_id WHERE b.user_id = #{userId} GROUP BY b.booking_id, s.site_no, st.type_name ORDER BY b.create_time DESC

SELECT b.booking_id, b.user_id, b.site_id, b.type_id, b.check_in, b.check_out, b.guest_name, b.guest_phone, b.total_price, b.status, b.create_time, b.update_time, s.site_no, st.type_name, COALESCE(string_agg(e.equip_name || 'x' || be.quantity, ', '), '') AS equipments FROM bookings b LEFT JOIN sites s ON b.site_id = s.site_id LEFT JOIN site_types st ON b.type_id = st.type_id LEFT JOIN booking_equips be ON b.booking_id = be.booking_id LEFT JOIN equipments e ON be.equip_id = e.equip_id WHERE b.user_id = #{userId} AND b.status = #{status} GROUP BY b.booking_id, s.site_no, st.type_name ORDER BY b.create_time DESC

SELECT booking_id, user_id, site_id, type_id, check_in, check_out, guest_name, guest_phone, total_price, status, create_time, update_time FROM bookings WHERE type_id = #{typeId} AND status IN (0, 1) AND NOT (check_out <= CAST(#{checkIn} AS DATE) OR check_in >= CAST(#{checkOut} AS DATE))
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO bookings (user_id, site_id, type_id, check_in, check_out, guest_name, guest_phone, total_price, status, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{userId}, #{siteId}, #{typeId}, CAST(#{checkIn} AS DATE), CAST(#{checkOut} AS DATE), #{guestName}, #{guestPhone}, #{totalPrice}, #{status}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime})
mapper.update: UPDATE bookings SET user_id = #{userId}, site_id = #{siteId}, type_id = #{typeId}, check_in = CAST(#{checkIn} AS DATE), check_out = CAST(#{checkOut} AS DATE), guest_name = #{guestName}, guest_phone = #{guestPhone}, total_price = #{totalPrice}, status = #{status}, update_time = #{updateTime} WHERE booking_id = #{bookingId}
mapper.select: SELECT b.booking_id, b.user_id, b.site_id, b.type_id, b.check_in, b.check_out, b.guest_name, b.guest_phone, b.total_price, b.status, b.create_time, b.update_time, s.site_no, st.type_name, u.username, COALESCE(string_agg(e.equip_name || 'x' || be.quantity, ', '), '') AS equipments FROM bookings b LEFT JOIN sites s ON b.site_id = s.site_id LEFT JOIN site_types st ON b.type_id = st.type_id LEFT JOIN users u ON b.user_id = u.user_id LEFT JOIN booking_equips be ON b.booking_id = be.booking_id LEFT JOIN equipments e ON be.equip_id = e.equip_id GROUP BY b.booking_id, s.site_no, st.type_name, u.username ORDER BY b.create_time DESC
